name: smwmusic-kirby-super-star-time-to-learn
title: Kirby Super Star - Time to Learn
description:
This is the short yet upbeat song that plays in the tutorial rooms in Kirby Super Star. By the way, do you know how I whipped up this unsampled version nearly an hour right after I submitted the sampled version? I simply removed the sampled version's samples and replaced the instruments, then I amplified the third channel and applied vibrato to it! Please see the tags for the appropriate themes.

Update: lowered instrument @30's volume.
